mainEntity.name: How do I choose between a shell or turnkey package for my metal home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The right choice depends on your budget structure, construction experience, and available time. A shell build fits buyers who have hands-on trades experience, want to finish rooms progressively out of pocket, or wish to act as their own project manager. A turnkey build is better if you work full-time, require fixed-price financing from a mortgage lender, or want a single licensed general contractor to coordinate schedules, inspections, and material deliveries from start to finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a shell if you have the time, skills, and cash flow to finish the interior yourself. Choose turnkey if you want guaranteed completion timelines and single-contractor accountability.
